approval_note: ACK 2026-10-06: standalone ETF macro decision board, outside the AVSHUNTER pipeline, reading its data read-only. All thresholds PROVISIONAL until measured on board snapshots.

conditions.rationale: 20-session change matches the 1-20 session thesis window; z-score against the trailing year makes 'rising/falling' relative to each series' own recorded volatility rather than a textbook level. Band 0.5 sd keeps roughly the middle third as 'stable'.

fred_publication_lag_days.rationale: FRED dates a value by observation date; it is published the next business day (H.4.1 weekly: Wednesday observation, Thursday release). A one-calendar-day lag minimum stops a session from seeing its own same-day print. Series released on a weekly calendar are in fred_release_calendar instead (one owner per series).

fred_release_calendar.rationale: Amended 2026-10-07 (point-in-time defect). Fed H.10 publishes the week's daily noon rates once, on the Monday after the observation week (Tuesday after a federal holiday such as Columbus Day, when markets are open). A 1-day lag let a mid-week session use rates published up to 5 sessions later. Local evidence: FRED manifest fetched 2026-10-06 shows DEXUSEU and the other H.10 series (DEXJPUS, DEXCHUS, DEXUSAL) last updated Monday 2026-10-05 15:16 CT with observations to Friday 2026-10-02. The Monday rule itself is Fed practice, not checked against a release calendar offline; ACK to confirm. Same-day convention as H.4.1: a value released on day R is used from session R (the board is read after the close; entries start next open). Max age is the weekly limit because the newest public value is up to 10 days old (Columbus Day Monday).

evidence.analog_rationale: Analog depth is chosen per build: the closest match level (share of today's observed conditions that agree) whose analog set still holds at least analog_target_effective_n independent 20-session windows; never looser than 0.6. 12 windows over the full history leaves ~8 in the train period (min_effective_n).
evidence.rationale: Forward returns start at the next session's open because the board is read after the close/pre-market; overlapping windows are thinned so n_eff counts independent windows; the last quarter of history is held out to check the lean was not fitted to the whole sample.
evidence.interval_rationale: Student-t interval for the mean on independent windows (thesis review: report uncertainty, the window minimum is only a label).

freshness.overnight_rationale: Added 2026-10-08 (step 5). The overnight capture is rewritten by every Run-MacroInputs run (PreOpen ~08:35 ET, PostClose ~16:30 ET), so a capture older than 12 hours belongs to an earlier run. PROVISIONAL.

path_dependent.rationale: Daily-reset and futures-roll products compound along the path; multi-session analog returns do not transfer mechanically (thesis s.14).

extension.rationale: Move already made, in the ETF's own 20-session realised vol; 1.5 sd marks a run large relative to its recent noise (thesis s.7, Scenario C). Descriptive label only.

response.rationale: Only condition contrasts with |t| >= 1 count as measured pressure; signs come from the board's own transmission evidence (thesis s.4).

options.rationale: Executable ATM straddle on the first expiry covering the horizon (runway rule), scaled by sqrt(time) to the horizon; compared with the analog mean absolute move (thesis s.8).

pipeline.rationale: Answers the desk card's 'What does the pipeline propose?' read-only; the board never changes or re-ranks it.

revision_note: 2026-10-08 rev f: morning / evening builds (only the evening build writes the scored snapshot) and the overnight capture on the Overview. 2026-10-06 rev e: momentum evidence (streak/extension measured, not assumed) and desk decision card.

holdings.rationale: Issuer daily holdings (ACK 6 Oct 2026): weight x return contribution and weight-share participation answer 'are the holdings that matter supporting the move?' (thesis s.6). Unpriced weight is shown, never treated as zero return.

tastytrade.rationale: Read-only broker metrics via bridge.tastytrade_readonly_mcp (needs the broker OAuth environment). IV-based expected |move| = IV x sqrt(h/252) x sqrt(2/pi), shown beside the executable straddle move.

rotation.rationale: Relative-rotation approximation (not JdK): 50-session RS trend and its 10-session momentum vs SPY; 8 weekly tail points. Relative leans use the board's analog sessions on sector-minus-SPY returns, with smaller minimum effects than absolute leans because relative moves are smaller. All PROVISIONAL.

correlation.rationale: ACK 16 Oct 2026: a live breakdown of the sectors and their correlation, to read market psychology. Daily-return correlation between the 11 sectors over 250 and 60 sessions and of returns relative to SPY (the rotation seesaw); per sector and industry ETF: correlation and beta to SPY, return on SPY's worst/best 10% of days as a multiple of SPY's move, a character label from beta (<0 hedge, <0.35 defensive, <0.8 partial, <1.2 market-like, else amplifier) and the outside asset most correlated with its relative move; crowding = average pairwise sector correlation over 60 sessions against its own history since 2021 (LOW at or below the 20th percentile: investors picking sectors; HIGH at or above the 80th: the crowd moving as one, usually on fear); shifts = pairs whose 60-session correlation differs from the 250-session one by 0.3 or more. Measured 16 Oct on the 250 sessions to 15 Oct: crowding 0.16, lower than 96% of its history (median 0.46). PROVISIONAL bands; display only, never a gate, score or rank.

momentum.rationale: ACK 6 Oct 2026: 'SPY and QQQ rose constantly over 7 days'. History 2021-2026 showed continuation after 5+ up closes (SPY 20d +2.19% vs +0.92% base; QQQ +2.86% vs +1.18%), so an extended move is judged by what followed similar runs for that ETF, never assumed late.

prices.rationale: Added 2026-10-09 (ACK: pre-market / latest data must supersede the pipeline's end of day). The pipeline's price store stays primary and is never written; the board fills completed sessions it lacks (behind the last completed session, or a ticker gap such as RSP/UUP since 20 Aug) from Polygon grouped daily bars, cached per session. A session counts 30 minutes after its close (late prints); a ticker's gap is filled whole or not at all: a gap needing more than 120 sessions still to fetch is left as it is and reported; sessions already cached cost no call and do not count (10 Oct 2026: the pipeline never fetches the 37 ETFs dropped from its universe on 16 May, or RSP/UUP, so their gaps grow one session a day and would otherwise pass 120 on 6 Nov 2026). Latest price: one Polygon snapshot per refresh build; a quote later than the board's close supersedes it as the current price (room, levels, focus cards); older than 30 minutes is flagged, never gated. PROVISIONAL.

review.rationale: Added 2026-10-09 (Daily review, section 1, ACK: daily bars v1). Threshold = 0.5 x the instrument's daily move (20-session realised vol of the sessions before the day). ABSORBED: close moved less than the threshold. REJECTED: gap beyond the threshold, close beyond it on the other side. ACCEPTED: otherwise. Each label is scored on what followed past days with the same label (next open to close 1/5/20 sessions, independent windows, held-out quarter). Constituent agreement: at least 60% of SPY's priced issuer weight moved with SPY on the day. PROVISIONAL until the label's own record is reviewed.

fomc.source: https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomccalendars.htm (read 2026-10-09). Dates are tentative until confirmed at the preceding meeting; sep = Summary of Economic Projections. Decision day = second meeting day.

decision_points.rationale: Added 2026-10-09 (Daily review, section 2, ACK). Earnings looked up for the top 15 issuer holdings of SPY/QQQ/DIA and the top 3 of each SPDR sector (MarketData, cached per session). A level within 1 daily move counts as a next-session decision point. Releases come from the overnight capture (FRED, 31-day lookahead); central-bank speakers from the event payload only. FRED release 101 is published daily, so FOMC decision days are kept here from the Fed calendar; update the list each year. PROVISIONAL.

opportunity.rationale: Added 2026-10-09 (Daily review, section 3, ACK). Leadership: QQQ minus SPY beyond the band per horizon, else NEITHER. Concentrated when equal-weight RSP lags SPY by 1 pp or more over 20 sessions, or under half of SPY's issuer weight trades above its 50-session average; BROAD needs both measures. Sector labels keep relative strength (vs SPY, beyond the band) apart from absolute direction. A sector move is CONFIRMED when at least 60% of its priced holdings weight moved the same way over the window. Room: nearest level above/below (252-session high/low, 50/200 averages, GEX walls/flip, pipeline target/invalidation) in % and in daily moves (20-session realised vol / sqrt(252)). All PROVISIONAL until scored.

desk_card.rationale: Checks describe evidence and never decide. Room = reward left to the pipeline target / risk left to its invalidation from today's close (>=1 ok, 0.5-1 caution, <0.5 against). Option price: priced-vs-history <=1.1 ok, >1.4 against; IV rank >=80 or straddle spread >5% of mid = caution. All PROVISIONAL.

action_text.ALIGNED: Aligned with {etf}'s tape and measured history: act on the pipeline's own trigger; the idea weakens if {etf} {fail} {level}.
action_text.MIXED: Mixed evidence: smaller size, and let {etf} {confirm} {level} after the open.
action_text.AGAINST: Against {etf}'s tape or measured history: wait for {etf} to {confirm} {level}, or stand aside.
action_text.NO_SECTOR_READ: No board read for this stock's sector ETF: judge it on its own chart.
action_text.STOCK_SPECIFIC: Stock-specific: it barely moves with {etf}, so judge it on its own chart and trigger; the market tape is {market}.

approach.UP_BROAD: Buyers accepted the news and participation is broad. Work with the move: add on pullbacks that hold the first level below, not on gaps into resistance. The first level below is the line for the idea.
approach.UP_NARROW: Buyers accepted the news, but a few large names carried it. Let the open confirm before adding; favour the leaders over the laggards and keep size smaller until equal weight joins in. A close back below the first level below is the warning.
approach.UP_UNKNOWN: Buyers accepted the news; breadth is not measured. Let the first hour confirm before adding; the first level below is the line.
approach.DOWN_BROAD: Sellers were accepted across the board. Respect the selling: do not buy the first bounce until it reclaims the first level above; long puts or standing aside fit better than catching the low.
approach.DOWN_NARROW: Selling was accepted but concentrated in a few large names. Avoid or hedge the weak groups; treat it as a market-wide turn only if equal weight follows.
approach.DOWN_UNKNOWN: Sellers were accepted; breadth is not measured. Wait for the first hour; the first level above is the line.
approach.MIXED: The index ETFs disagreed: no clean acceptance either way. Treat it as a two-way market: trade the edges of the range with smaller size and wait for a level to break with breadth before committing.
approach.UNKNOWN: Not enough reaction data to read the tape; rely on the levels and the checklist.

expression_text.CHEAP: Options price less movement than history delivered after similar days: long calls/puts are reasonably priced for the move; pick an expiry beyond the runway.
expression_text.FAIR: Options price about what history delivered: long premium needs the move inside the runway; shares carry no time decay.
expression_text.RICH: Options price more movement than history delivered: premium is expensive; shares or a smaller premium position fit better.
expression_text.UNKNOWN: No current option pricing on the board: check the chain before choosing an expression.

session_plan.conflict_note: Published narratives disagree with what the market measured ({pieces}). The tape is the measured fact; treat the narratives as the risk to watch, not the call.
session_plan.rationale: Added 2026-10-10 (ACK: the board is confusing; a veteran-trader synthesis for the next session, all pieces fitting together; sentences from measured fields, not an LLM). Tape = which way the index ETFs closed (a rejected down gap counts as buyers); 3 of 4 = a direction, else MIXED. Scenario triggers are the nearest board levels around the current price, targets the next level (else one implied move; a next level more than 5 daily moves away is shown as the next mapped level, not the target). A scenario is marked only where the reaction history measured a lean. Options CHEAP below 0.9x / RICH above 1.1x the move history delivered (straddle vs analog mean |move|, 5-session horizon); runway = 2x the horizon (ACK: buy more time than the move). US Money Index score >=60 reads risk-off, <=40 risk-on. Agreement is a count, not a probability. Wording is editable here. Per ETF (ACK 10 Oct 2026): every board ETF gets its reaction, levels, beta/correlation to SPY and QQQ (60 sessions), what SPY's scenario targets imply through beta, and its measured Money Index band history; a pipeline proposal is checked against them (5-session horizon, an obstacle within 0.5 daily moves counts against). The pipeline's top 200 CALL/PUT candidates, in its ranked order, are read through the pipeline's own sector_etf and their correlation to it (below 0.4 = weak link: the sector read carries little, so the reading is STOCK_SPECIFIC and the stock is judged on its own chart). Confirmation levels are market levels only, never the pipeline's own target or invalidation. Checks describe evidence; the human decides. Display only; all PROVISIONAL.

scenario_verdict_text.EDGE: history: the option paid more than buying every session
scenario_verdict_text.OPPOSITE: history: the opposite side paid; the hypothesis has been wrong
scenario_verdict_text.NO_EDGE: history: no better than buying every session
scenario_verdict_text.THIN: history: too few independent triggers to judge

scenario_fdr_text.fail: within chance across the library's tests

components.label: Breadth (share of tickers above their 50-session mean)
AI / semis leadership (SMH vs SPY, 5 sessions)

money_index.rationale: Added 2026-10-10 (ACK: build the measured parts of the ChatGPT Money Index locally, shown beside it; the plan works per ETF with its correlation). Seven of the published ladder's nine components are measured from data held, with the published weights (76 of 100) so the two compare component by component; geopolitics and Hormuz stay LLM-only. Each component is scored against its own trailing 252 sessions (percentile, oriented to risk-off): 0 points at or below the median, full weight at the 95th percentile, linear between - calibrated on recorded data instead of fixed levels that go stale (the published file carried 10Y thresholds of 4.80/4.85% while the 10Y was 5.23%). A session with any component missing has no score. Bands: below 35 calm, 60+ risk-off. What followed each band is measured per ETF with the board's evidence rules; beta/correlation to SPY and QQQ on 60 sessions of daily returns; information coefficient = rank correlation of the score with the next 5-session return on non-overlapping windows. Display only. All PROVISIONAL.

measured_sheet.title: AVSHUNTER measured sheet - paste this before your ChatGPT macro request
instructions: This sheet describes the US close of {session}. Use every number in it exactly as given: do not restate, round, re-source or replace it, and do not look up your own value for anything listed here.

US Money Index (avshunter_us_money_index.json, contract unchanged): in risk_off_transmission_score.components set the seven measured components from section 1 - score = our points, weight = our weight, status = MEASURED_BY_AVSHUNTER, evidence = the row from the table. Score only {llm_components} yourself, each with evidence, source and time.

Set risk_off_transmission_score.current_score to the sum of all nine component scores (the measured points in section 1 + your {llm_weight} news points; weights total 100, no score above its weight), set current_state.risk_off_transmission_score to the same number so the pipeline contract reconciles, and say in current_interpretation that {measured_weight} of the 100 points were measured by AVSHUNTER.

Event payload (avshunter_us_economic_event_payload_<date>.json): for scheduled US releases use the actual and prior values in section 4; add a consensus forecast only with its source; add unscheduled developments (geopolitics, policy, corporate) with source and time.
News enrichment (avshunter_macro_enrichment_delta.json): use section 2 for how markets reacted and section 4 for overnight moves; add the narrative, event guards and candidate tickers from the news.
Where the news disagrees with a measured fact here, keep the measured fact and record the disagreement explicitly (cross_asset_contradictions, data_quality.discrepancy_register).
Keep every file's schema, keys and contract version unchanged and return valid JSON only.
needed_from_you: Geopolitical escalation and Hormuz: state, evidence, source and time for each.
Weekly fund flows (equity, bond, money-market): source and week ending.
Consensus forecasts for the scheduled releases in section 4, with their source.
Unscheduled developments since the last close that could move US markets, with source and time.
Candidate tickers from the news, with the catalyst and its date.
measured_sheet.rationale: Added 2026-10-10 (ACK: build the measured sheet with the instructions included). Every board build writes macro_board/output/measured_sheet_latest.md (and sheets/measured_sheet_<session>_<kind>.md): facts AVSHUNTER measured itself, assembled from the board payload without an LLM, for ACK to paste into ChatGPT so the LLM adds only the news layer and cannot contradict local numbers (one owner per fact). The sheet never carries an LLM's published numbers and writes MISSING where a fact is missing. Instruction wording is editable here.

scheduled_events.rationale: Added 2026-10-10 (ACK: build the scheduled part of the event payload locally; ChatGPT keeps the unscheduled news). The release list mirrors the overnight capture's OVERNIGHT_RELEASES (Enhancements/colab/avshunter_market_intelligence_v5_4_3.py) - update both together. FRED release dates give the calendar; the print is read as known on the release day (vintage) with the previous value's revision since first published. Surprise = the latest change against the series' own past 36 changes, |z| >= 1 above/below trend - there is no free consensus source, so it is never called a consensus surprise. Event-day history = mean |close-to-close move| on the release's past sessions vs other sessions (shown from 12 release days). Refresh builds read FRED (cached per session under output/external/fred_events); a failed or keyless read falls back to the overnight capture. Written as output/events/us_scheduled_events_<session>.json in the event payload schema (route SCHEDULED_RELEASES_MEASURED). Display only. PROVISIONAL.

option_proxy.rationale: No historical option quotes before Sep 2025, so the proxy prices an ATM option by Black-Scholes with implied vol = 20-session realised vol x 1.15, flat over the hold; expiry = 2x the horizon (runway rule); bought at the ask and sold at the bid with a 3% round-trip spread on premium (liquid ETF straddles quoted ~0.7-1.5% of mid on 5 Oct). PROVISIONAL until the stored chains can replace it.

scenario_watch.rationale: ACK 6 Oct 2026: forward-looking, condition-based trade reasons per ETF (e.g. QQQ cannot hold a yearly high for 3 sessions -> puts). Every scenario is pre-registered here with its date, measured on all history per ETF on long-option expectancy after costs vs buying every session, held-out checked, shown with its forward status, and recorded live on evening builds. Display only: never scores, ranks or gates.

scenario_watch.fdr_rationale: Every scenario x ETF x horizon result is one try; Benjamini-Hochberg at a 10% false-discovery rate marks the results that beat the number of tries (pre-registered, trial-counted).

options_flow.guards_basis: Measured 14 Oct 2026 on the stored iv_surface_history (8-30 DTE bucket, ~70 dates): median day-to-day change of 25-delta skew is 1.0-2.5 pts for SPY/QQQ/IWM/DIA/XLK/SMH/SOXX but 10-50 pts for XLI/XLV/KRE/XHB/XLF/XLP/XLY/XLC/IYR/XRT/XLU/XLRE/KBE/XLB (not plausible for real skew); ATM IV median daily change relative to its level 0.04-0.13 for liquid ETFs (SPY 0.10, SMH 0.07), 0.16-0.45 for KRE/IYT/XLC/IYR/XRT/XLRE/KBE/XLB/XLU/XLP; contracts captured per day vary (XLE 179 vs 213). A series is read only if its own median daily change is within the limit; a change is flagged only if larger than 90% of its own daily changes; volume and OI compare only dates with chain coverage within 10%.

day_story.rationale: ACK 14 Oct 2026: a Day story tab listing the day's possible scenarios, the news and an explicit trade analysis, with narratives of why money flows into or out of each sector and how it reaches tickers. Narrator = both, clearly labelled: MEASURED templates plus a Claude narrative fed only the measured facts (numbers not in the facts and flow calls that contradict the measurement are flagged). Flow = relative return vs SPY over 5 and 20 sessions using the opportunity bands (one owner); drivers = conditions in today's state with a measured response |t| >= 2 at 5 sessions, and assets the ETF's relative return has moved with (|corr| >= 0.3, 60 sessions); option footprints = stored MarketData chains (iv_surface_history) against each ticker's own 60 stored dates; published news = event payload items matched by keyword, not verified. The trade side follows the flow, but each flow label's own history (next 5 sessions, |t| >= 2) is shown as FOLLOWS / REVERSES / NO_CLEAR_RECORD and counted for or against: measured 14 Oct 2026, leaders that turn out (XLK, SMH, SOXX) have bounced back over the next 5 sessions and real estate turning in has faded, so following those reads is against the evidence. Each session's flow calls go to the ledger and are scored on the next 1 and 5 sessions; the historical record of each flow label is shown beside it. PROVISIONAL thresholds until the ledger validates them. Display only: never a gate, score or rank.
